ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Earthstone Holding (Two) Private Limited, a member of the promoter group for Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd., increased its stake by acquiring 46,958 equity shares through open market purchases on September 25, 2026. This minor acquisition raised their total holding from 3.699% to 3.710% of the target company's share capital, reflecting a routine, incremental increase in promoter ownership. There are no material impacts or red flags associated with this transaction, as it is a standard regulatory disclosure rather than an indicator of significant corporate action or control changes.
